rationale: Flooding has caused damage to the policyholder's own basement structure (hardwood floor, drywall) and stored contents (boxes), which is clearly property damage regardless of the water source.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement has approximately 2 inches of standing water affecting the entire floor, with buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to 1 foot, and ruined stored boxes. This is a high-severity property damage claim with extensive structural and contents damage; the adjuster should investigate the water source during the initial assessment.

case_facts.description: Basement flooding with approximately 2 inches of water; hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot, stored boxes ruined

rationale: Wind-caused damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles) is clear property damage to the home's exterior.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to back porch roof overhang with approximately four shingles blown off (no interior leaking or secondary damage). Estimated repair cost is $400. The claim is below the $2,500 deductible, but routed for adjuster review and documentation.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off, no interior damage or leaking
